Financial Assistance Policy
Section 4. Eligibility. Uninsured patients and patients with high medical costs may apply.
Full Charity Care: Patients with family income from 0% to 200% of the Federal Poverty Level (FPL) receive a 100% discount on charges.
Partial Charity / Discount Payment: Patients with family income between 201% and 400% of the FPL are eligible for a discount so that they pay no more than the amount Medicare would pay.
Patients above 400% FPL with medical expenses exceeding 10% of family income may also qualify.
Questions? Call our Financial Counselors at 1-800-555-0199 Monday through Friday.
